response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive full-stack experience across multiple domains, including TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Kubernetes, with a strong emphasis on scalable architectures and clean code. His background in renewable energy-adjacent projects (GISCollective) and renewable energy workflows (re:cinq) aligns well with the role's focus on energy consulting and renovation platforms. While his experience skews senior, his adaptability and pragmatic problem-solving approach suggest he could thrive in a mid-level role.
strengths: Deep full-stack expertise with TypeScript, React, and Node.js across multiple industries
Proven track record in scalable, high-performance systems (e.g., Direct Mail automation at Optilyz, real-time data at Dunnhumby)
Strong alignment with renewable energy/construction tech through GISCollective and re:cinq projects
concerns: Overqualified for junior level with extensive senior/lead experience (10+ years) and high-level roles
Limited direct exposure to PostgreSQL or Nest.js, core requirements for the role
German language skills are basic, which may impact on-site collaboration requirements
